newsitem.title: THAILAND: RESEARCH ALERT - Thai Engine rated "buy".
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Thai Engine rated "buy".

text.p: Seamico Securities Plc on Tuesday rated Thai Engine Manufacturing Plc a "buy" at 234 baht ($9.36), saying the farm diesel engine producer's earnings are expected to rise sharply in 1996 and 1997.

Seamico said Thai Engine, currently enjoying a 24 percent share of the over 200,000-unit Thai farm engine market, will likely see earnings growth of 66 percent in 1996 and another 52 percent profit rise in 1997.
Thai Engine fell two baht to 232 during morning trade on Tuesday.

Seamico said Thai Engine was one of a few Thai stocks that have bucked the extended bearish trend of the Thai bourse. Its share price gained 84 percent in the past six months against a 25 percent decline of the composite SET Index.

But it said: "As the stock has been one of the best outperformers, we do not expect much further upside in the short-run...the stock is unlikely to be a beneficiary of a SET potential rebound in the short-term."

Seamico said Thai Engine raised its Thai market share to about 24 percent this year from 15 percent in 1995 and less than 10 percent a year earlier. The company aims to increase it to 40 percent within the next few years.
It has an exclusive distribution right of Mitsubishi farm engines in Indochina and the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) except Indonesia.
Seamico said Thai Engine plans to spend about 300 million baht this year and another 200 million baht in 1997 to expand its 60,000-unit annual production capacity and for a venture in Vietnam.
